main.description: One way into some of the author's gated spaces on plyr.fm. A space can carry any number of policies of any kinds; a reader who passes one may read every space it names. Whatever a space holds (a track, a release's tracks, a playlist) is opened as a whole. One policy over several spaces lets one purchase open an album and the single it shares a track with.

spaces.description: The spaces this policy opens, each at://{author}/space/{type}/{skey}. Only the author's own spaces count. Older records carry a single 'space' string instead; readers accept either, never both.

space.description: Deprecated: one space. Read for older records; write spaces.

subject.description: What the policy sells or grants, usually an fm.plyr.release, for display.

rule.description: What a reader must satisfy. Readers apply only the rules they know; an unknown rule opens nothing.

title.description: Short name shown to readers, e.g. 'buy the album' or 'friends'.

members.description: The listed accounts. The list is public.

supporter.description: Anyone holding a broker-verified network.attested.payment record to the author, of any amount.

brokers.description: Brokers whose payment proofs count. Absent: the reading app's trusted brokers.

purchase.description: Anyone holding a broker-verified network.attested.payment record to the author, at or above this price, whose entitlements include this policy record.

amount.description: Price in the currency's smallest unit, as attested.network records amounts.

brokers.description: Brokers whose payment proofs count. Absent: the reading app's trusted brokers.
